Description: Tamura belongs to the Alan household of Boz-Uruz and is the mother of Amage and Opis. Both daughters can form views of their own, so her concern extends beyond protecting them to deciding who may make promises on their behalf. In dealings between households she asks what the other side expects and what help it will offer in danger. She values mutual support without treating kinship as an unlimited claim on another person. Concern for her daughters can make her overly cautious, but she is prepared to reconsider when they explain their reasons. She will help people who have lost support while first considering food, care and safety for those travelling with them. She refuses grand promises made merely to attract praise. What troubles her most is an arrangement made in the family’s name whose consequences are left to her and her daughters.
